description: Manual live evaluation corpus. Keep visual fidelity, ecological invention, subjective appearance and operational reliability separate.

criteria.label: At least one visible structural or behavioral cue relates to feline inspiration.
The result presents a coherent invented animal rather than only recoloring an ordinary cat.
Visible habitat and activity agree with the saved biology and field note.
The subject is recognizable as a cat.
No unrelated animal lineage or radical body transformation has been introduced.

settings.prompt: A cat-inspired animal with exactly four legs, two ears and one long tail. It has matte black fur with a single white ring around its tail. Show it hunting small crabs among wet tidal rocks, in a square wildlife photograph. No horns, wings or extra limbs.
requiredFeatures: Exactly four legs, two ears and one long tail
Matte black fur with one white tail ring
Hunting small crabs among wet tidal rocks
excludedFeatures: Wings or structures that visually resemble wings

criteria.label: Four legs, two ears and one tail; mark unscorable if occlusion prevents an exact count.
Matte black fur and exactly one white tail ring are visible.
The animal visibly hunts small crabs among wet tidal rocks.
No wings or visually equivalent membranes, horns or extra limbs are visible.

settings.prompt: An elongated translucent animal swims through a cold kelp forest using gentle fin waves. No walking legs, feet or standing pose.

criteria.label: The visible organism has no walking legs or feet; fins and sensory threads are not legs.
The pose and environmental contact support swimming rather than standing.
The saved biology, zero leg count and visible locomotion agree.

settings.prompt: An ordinary red fox in strict side view. Show its entire body, four legs, two ears and one tail, unobscured and fully inside the frame.
requiredFeatures: Unobscured anatomy in strict side view

criteria.label: The full fox silhouette, including ears, feet and tail, is inside the frame.
Foreground objects do not obscure the organism.
The subject is shown in side view with assessable anatomy.

settings.prompt: An ordinary black cat in side view, standing with its full body and tail visible. Isolate the animal on a transparent background.

criteria.label: The downloaded PNG has actual transparent background pixels, not a painted checkerboard.
The whole animal is visible without clipping or habitat objects.

settings.prompt: An ordinary barn owl perched upright on one short branch. Keep the entire bird in the frame in a portrait composition.

criteria.label: The output dimensions are portrait 2:3, allowing only minor rounding.
The entire owl fits inside the portrait frame.

cases.instructions: Change only the black fur to rust-orange. Preserve the single white tail ring, pose, crab positions, rocks, water, lighting and framing. Keep exactly four legs, two ears and one tail, with no horns, wings or extra limbs.

criteria.label: The fur has changed from black to rust-orange while the single white tail ring remains.
The main pose, crab positions, rocks, water, lighting and framing remain visually consistent with the source.
The organism identity and anatomy remain consistent; no new appendages appear.
